name: Sensbachtal (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Sensbachtal (a wheel and stars on green divided by a white wavy bend).
history: The flag was approved for the municipality by the Hessian Ministry of the Interior on 12 May 1986. A former municipality: Sensbachtal merged with Beerfelden, Hesseneck and Rothenberg into the city of Oberzent on 1 January 2018.

features.role: Sensbachtal arms — wheel, stars and wavy bend on green
